intro.title: Marketing Hall
intro.body: Here the moves of the marketing war are gathered: choose a project, grasp the problem, prepare your offer, deploy promotion, and keep the campaign within your watch.

toolbar.title: House, project, and evidence
toolbar.body: In the top strip you choose house, project, and evidence. There too: refresh, link to the current screen, and quick actions.

sidebar.title: Campaign map
sidebar.body: Sections are grouped by meaning: setup, positioning, audience, promotion, work, evidence, and Oracles.

overviewMode.title: Watch mode
overviewMode.body: Overview shows what matters now: money, mandates, threats, gaps, and the next moves.

dashboardToolbar.title: Summary panel
dashboardToolbar.body: Layout templates, filter and template search, add tiles, import and export, and quick signs (?).

widgetChrome.title: Tile frame
widgetChrome.body: Each tile has a title, type icon, and actions: guidance on the name, then pin, hide, or remove from the tile header menu.

dashboardGrid.title: Tile grid
dashboardGrid.body: Drag and resize tiles. Tile menu and right-click context menu — pin, duplicate, hide.

ewaGuide.kbdHint: Navigate with arrow keys, Home and End; close with Escape.

intro.title: Assistant
intro.body: This is your friend on the desktop: chat, memory, plan, and workspace actions. It is not Assistant — this window is your personal Assistant and its context.

presence.title: Presence
presence.body: The sigil, name, and mood show how the Assistant feels nearby. Tap the sigil when a special persona mode is available.

left-rail.title: Memory and plan
left-rail.body: On the left: hints, what the Assistant remembers, your plan, and the next step. On narrow screens this block moves above the transcript.

transcript.title: Conversation
transcript.body: Message history and Assistant replies live here. Long tasks may show progress banners in the thread.

operations.title: Current operations
operations.body: On the right: background jobs such as music, documents, or generation. Track status and play results without leaving chat.

quick-presets.title: Quick prompts
quick-presets.body: Saved phrases and tools under the input field so you do not retype the same requests.

composer.title: Message
composer.body: Type text, attach an image, use voice, or send. Enter sends; Shift+Enter adds a new line.

outro.title: Done
outro.body: Close the tour and start chatting. You can reopen it anytime from the Tour button in the header.
